newsitem.title: THAILAND: PTTEP plans 35 bln baht natgas investment.
newsitem.headline: PTTEP plans 35 bln baht natgas investment.

text.p: PTT Exploration and Production Plc, the exploration arm of the Petroleum Authority of Thailand, said on Wednesday it plans to invest 35 billion baht in natural gas development between 1997-2001.

The investments would focus on the development of the B12/27 Pailin project and the Bongkot project in the Gulf of Thailand, the Moattama project in the Andaman Sea off Burma where the Yadana gas field was located and the Malaysia-Thailand Joint Development Area project.
PTTEP said it was also considering long term potential investments in the region and the Middle East.
